source: Peyre de Fabrègues et al. 2020, Scientific Reports 10 (Irisosaurus yimenensis), Fig. 12: time-calibrated tree of early sauropodomorphs against a Triassic-Jurassic stage header, black range bars (dashed for uncertain ranges), numbered nodes 1-7 marked by small squares or a dot, and Sauropoda as an arrow; rectangular, root left. Image: census 3 figure (2008x2278 px), the embedded raster.
names_note: no matrix held; list = the printed tip names (genera; Irisosaurus in red; Sauropoda the arrow tip)
gold_note: Sauropodomorph time tree, read by eye at 1-2x; fully resolved. The node numbers 1-7 are not encoded; the range bars and the Sauropoda arrow are not branches (the arrow is the tip Sauropoda). 39 tips, fully resolved. Sample 9 case (census 3, seed 20261272). Topology transcribed from the figure image and checked node by node; topology only.
region_note: the tree, below the stage header (y < 420)
lift_ground_note: the tree is drawn on a ground of purple running to blue, which is lifted to white as a person would ask for it with --lift-ground (Sarah's decision of 2026-11-27). The sample's cold result was taken without it: 14 of 39 names.
